name: Ghostrick Yoko
desc:
2 Level 2 "Ghostrick" monsters
You can only Special Summon "Ghostrick Yoko(s)" from the Extra Deck once per turn. You can also Xyz Summon this card by using 1 face-down Defense Position "Ghostrick" monster you control that has a Level. Cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Ghostrick" monster from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters.
